bio:
Portuguese in Seoul. Eleven years of engineering across cybersecurity, distributed systems, and crypto; two as a CTO in VC-backed startups. I like hard systems and the strange places where they meet money.

Now I spend my days on two things:
Nieusync — consulting that automates processes and unblocks ops.
Ziku — software that cuts costs and scales operations.

In between, I’m rebuilding how I work around agents.
